compositionRules.incompatibleStates: Never combine mutually exclusive conditions into one apparent app screen; compact rows/sections are independent specimens.
compositionRules.captions: Source/title/role/state are recorded here as metadata; optional external labels never become product UI. Missing outer caption alone is not a functional failure.
compositionRules.legibility: Every field/action/row must remain readable at reference scale. Increase artifact canvas or split this job if necessary; never shrink or delete content to meet a job count.

originalManifest.generationInstruction: Read generation-execution-contract.md. Use actual template/role and selected baseline visible state before generic plan text. Submit a concise exact prompt for this one asset; full source/state/field/action contracts remain in this manifest and original plan. Draw independent labeled matrix rows/panels as specified, not incompatible states in one product page. Local component designs do not redraw full host. Full pages use their actual role-specific shell. Source-derived states are examples, not runtime acceptance. No invented features/inputs/buttons/permissions or fake saved/connected outcomes. Keep every existing visible action and actual disabled guard. Save full actual submittedPrompt and input responsibilities in SHA-bound sidecar, pending independent review.

submittedPrompt: 制作中文图谱“筛选与路径”手机弹窗，两独立窄列A/B，A390/B320比例，正常字号不缩小。白底细线圆角，中性浅灰外背景，不画宿主导航和系统栏。标题“筛选与路径”、描述“缩小范围，聚焦值得探索的联系。”、右上关闭X。真实长表单内部竖向滚动，A上半部，B同一表单下半部，细滚动条清楚。A依序：目录下拉“知识库根目录”；节点类型多选placeholder“全部类型”；关系类型多选placeholder“全部关系”；label“关系线索”下三个checkbox顺序“显示待审核候选”（未勾）、“显示语义相似（向量）”（已勾）、“仅孤立节点”（未勾）；label“最低语义相似度”滑条及只读值“0.65”，说明“余弦分数越高，内容越相近。每篇笔记保留最相近的少量连接。”，后续向下滚动。B滚到下半部：先label“最低置信度”滑条与只读“0%”；接着展开的“路径与范围”；label“节点颜色”下拉“按类型”；label“起点”可搜索下拉placeholder“选择起点”；label“终点”下拉placeholder“选择终点”；label“节点上限”数字输入“80”；蓝色按钮“查找路径”，自然可达。长label换行，不把滑条只读数值画成输入，不加应用/取消/重置按钮，不删除高级字段。
